svg.aria-label: What pulls me in. AI: Agents that do real work. At NFCtron I roll out an internal Slack agent and shared tooling for coding agents, and Keyhop tracks the accounts my own agents run on. Complex systems: Many moving parts that have to agree: payments, terminals, cards and access control, all at once.
